ML Benchmark Replay

Score genuine ULB/Worldline dataset rows with the saved trained models. Server-side inference only.

ULB benchmark inference — not live real-world transaction prediction.

Models were trained and evaluated on the public ULB/Worldline credit-card dataset. Uploads must contain the published columns (Time, Amount, V1–V28; optional Class). Scores are uncalibrated ranking scores, not calibrated fraud probabilities. Use the Analysis page for the rules-based baseline on ordinary transactions.
